f.title: Report new product information such as adverse effects to DRAP
f.statement: Any new information available for the product, such as adverse effects, changes in formulation or in the manufacturer of the active ingredients or finished products, must be reported to DRAP.

rows.quote: Any new information available for the product such as adverse effects, changes in formulation
rows.review_note: Review: quote stops at a page footer; "must be reported to the DRAP" follows the footer. Double-check: statement matches the full sentence; level from "must".

f.title: Report any adverse reaction immediately to the Pharmacy Services Division
f.statement: As per Rule 8(5) of the Bio-Study Rules, any adverse reaction shall be reported immediately to the Pharmacy Services Division, DRAP.

rows.quote: All applicants informed that, as per Rule 8(5) any adverse reaction shall be reported immediately to the Pharmacy Services Division-DRAP.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: PI reports all SAEs to ethics committees and sponsor, copied to DRAP, within 7 calendar days
f.statement: The principal investigator shall report all serious adverse events (SAEs), expected or unexpected, to the IRB/IEC/ERC/IRCs and the sponsor, with copies to the Pharmacy Services Division, DRAP, as soon as possible but not later than seven calendar days upon receiving notice of the event.

rows.deadline: As soon as possible, not later than 7 calendar days upon receiving notice
rows.quote: The PI shall report to IRB / IEC / ERC / IRCs and the Sponsor with copies to Pharmacy Services Division, DRAP all serious adverse events (SAEs), both expected or unexpected, as soon as possible but not later than seven (07) calendar days upon receiving notice of such event.
rows.review_note: Review: origin domestic (sites in Pakistan). Double-check: confirmed.

deadline_rule.applies_to: All SAEs (expected or unexpected) at Pakistani sites

f.title: Bind the PI to report SAEs immediately to the sponsor, with written follow-up by subject code
f.statement: The sponsor shall bind the principal investigator to report all SAEs immediately to the sponsor, except those the protocol identifies as not requiring immediate reporting. The immediate report shall be followed by detailed written reports; immediate and follow-up reports shall identify subjects by unique code numbers.
f.exceptions: SAEs the protocol identifies as not requiring immediate reporting
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.deadline: Immediately; followed by detailed written reports
rows.quote: The Sponsor shall bound the Principal Investigator to report all Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) immediately to him except for those the research protocol identifies as not requiring immediate reporting. The immediate report shall be followed by detailed, written reports. The immediate and follow-up reports shall identify subjects by unique code numbers assigned to the latter.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Report protocol-critical AEs and lab abnormalities to the sponsor per protocol
f.statement: Adverse events and laboratory abnormalities identified in the protocol as critical to safety evaluations shall be reported to the sponsor according to the reporting requirements and within the time periods specified in the protocol.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.deadline: Within the time periods specified in the protocol
rows.quote: Adverse events and laboratory abnormalities identified in the protocol as critical to safety evaluations shall be reported to the Sponsor according to the reporting requirements and within the time periods specified in the protocol.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: PI supplies additional information on subject deaths on request
f.statement: For reported deaths of a subject, the principal investigator shall supply the sponsor, the ethics committee and the Authority with any additional information requested.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: For reported deaths of a subject, the Principal Investigator shall supply the Sponsor and the Ethics Committee and the Authority with any additional information requested.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Keep detailed records of all AEs reported by investigators and submit them with the research report
f.statement: The sponsor shall keep detailed records of all adverse events reported to it by the PIs or site investigators; these records shall be submitted to the Pharmacy Services Division/CSC, addressed to the Chairman or Secretary CSC, in connection with the clinical research report.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Data integrity & records

rows.quote: The Sponsor shall keep detailed records of all adverse events which are reported to him by the PIs or Site-Investigators. These records shall be submitted to the Pharmacy Services Division/CSC addressing the Chairman CSC / Secretary CSC in connection to the Clinical Research report.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Record and report domestic fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 7 calendar days
f.statement: The sponsor and/or PI shall ensure that all relevant information about domestic fatal or life-threatening SUSARs occurring in a clinical investigation is recorded and reported to the Pharmacy Services Division/CSC as soon as possible and no later than seven calendar days after knowledge of the case by the sponsor and/or PI.

rows.deadline: As soon as possible, no later than 7 calendar days after knowledge
rows.quote: the Sponsor and/or PI shall ensure that all relevant information about domestic Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions (SUSAR) occurring in clinical investigation, that are fatal or life-threatening are recorded and reported as soon as possible, and in any case no later than seven (07) calendar days after knowledge by the Sponsor and/or PI of such a case,
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed.

deadline_rule.clock_start: knowledge by the Sponsor and/or PI of such a case

f.title: Communicate follow-up on fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 8 additional calendar days
f.statement: Relevant follow-up information on domestic fatal or life-threatening SUSARs shall subsequently be communicated within an additional eight calendar days.

rows.deadline: Within 8 additional calendar days after the 7-day report
rows.quote: and the relevant follow-up information is subsequently communicated within additional eight (08) calendar days;
rows.review_note: Review: split from the 7-day row. Double-check: confirmed.

deadline_rule.clock_start: seven (07) calendar days after knowledge by the Sponsor and/or PI of such a case
deadline_rule.applies_to: Follow-up of domestic fatal or life-threatening SUSARs; 8 days additional to the 7-day period

f.title: Report other domestic SUSARs within 15 calendar days of first knowledge
f.statement: All other domestic SUSARs that are not fatal or life-threatening shall be reported as soon as possible but within a maximum of fifteen calendar days of first knowledge by the sponsor and/or PI.

rows.deadline: As soon as possible, within 15 calendar days of first knowledge
rows.quote: (SUSARs) that are not fatal life-threatening shall be reported as soon as possible but within a maximum of fifteen calendar days of first knowledge by the sponsor and/or PI;
rows.review_note: Review: quote starts after a page footer (sentence begins "(b) all other domestic suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions"). Double-check: confirmed.

deadline_rule.clock_start: first knowledge by the sponsor and/or PI
deadline_rule.applies_to: Domestic SUSARs that are not fatal or life-threatening

f.title: Do not expedite non-serious AEs/ADRs; include them in periodic reports
f.statement: Non-serious AEs or ADRs shall not be reported on an expedited basis but shall be included in the periodic reports.

rows.quote: and Non-serious AEs or ADRs shall not be reported on expedite basis but shall be included in the periodic reports.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Submit DSURs in ICH E2F format for all ongoing trials in Pakistan
f.statement: The sponsor and/or PI shall submit a DSUR in the ICH E2F format for as long as the sponsor conducts clinical trials/research in Pakistan with the investigational drug; the DSUR shall be submitted for all ongoing clinical trials, covering trials the sponsor is conducting or completed during the review period: Phase I-III trials with an investigational drug, Phase IV trials in approved indications, other therapeutic use (expanded access, compassionate use, named patient use) and comparability trials supporting manufacturing changes.

rows.quote: The Sponsor and/or PI shall submit DSUR as per International Council on Harmonization (ICH-E2F) format for as long as the Sponsor conducts clinical trials/research in Pakistan with the investigational drug. For the ease of manufacturer or drug registration holder or sponsor, the DSUR shall be submitted for all ongoing clinical trials.
rows.review_note: Review: scope list (a)-(d) added to the statement. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Submit the DSUR annually within 60 calendar days of its data lock point
f.statement: The DSUR shall be submitted annually no later than sixty calendar days from the DSUR's data lock point (DLP). The DLP of the DSUR should be based on the "Initial Blinding Date (IBD)" as written in the source (probably meant: international birth date).

rows.deadline: Annually, no later than 60 calendar days from the DSUR DLP
rows.quote: The DSUR shall be submitted annually no later than sixty calendar days from the DSUR’s DLP. The DLP of the DSUR should be based on Initial Blinding Date (IBD).
rows.review_note: Review: source says "Initial Blinding Date (IBD)", most likely an error for the international birth date (DIBD); statement keeps the abbreviation neutral. Double-check: 60-day deadline verbatim.

f.title: Prepare both PBRER and DSUR after accelerated approval and synchronise the DLP
f.statement: If the investigational drug has received accelerated approval or registration and clinical trials continue or are initiated, both a PBRER (ICH E2C(R2) format) and a DSUR should be prepared. The sponsor shall change the DSUR's DLP to coincide with the IBD so that the DSUR and PBRER can be synchronised; the period covered by the next DSUR should be no longer than one year.
f.applicability: Investigational drugs with accelerated approval or registration and continuing or new trials

rows.quote: If the investigational drug has received accelerated approval or registration, and clinical trials continue or are initiated, both a PBRER (as per ICH-E2C (R2) format) and a DSUR should be prepared in accordance with ICH-GCP Guidelines. The Sponsor shall change the DSUR’s, DLP to coincide with the IBD so that the DSUR and the PBRER can be synchronized. In synchronizing the DLP for the DSUR and PBRER, the period covered by the next DSUR should be no longer than one year.
rows.review_note: Review: mixed modal (should prepare / shall change DLP); headline level Mandatory from the DLP alignment duty. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Mark the final DSUR as the last annual report and state whether trials continue elsewhere
f.statement: When submission of an annual DSUR is no longer required, the sponsor should indicate that the final DSUR serves as the last annual report for the investigational drug, and should also indicate whether clinical trials are continuing elsewhere.

rows.quote: When submission of an annual DSUR report is no longer required, the sponsor should indicate that the final DSUR serves as the last annual report for the investigational drug. The sponsor should also indicate whether or not clinical trials are continuing elsewhere.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Provide additional follow-up information within 15 calendar days
f.statement: Additional follow-up information should be made available to the Pharmacy Services Division, DRAP, as soon as possible and in any case not later than fifteen calendar days.

rows.deadline: As soon as possible, not later than 15 calendar days (start not stated)
rows.quote: Additional follow up information should be made available to Pharmacy Services Division, DRAP as soon as possible, but in any case, not later than fifteen (15) calendar days.
rows.review_note: Review: no deadline_rule because the source states no clock start. Double-check: should = Recommended; scope (SUSAR or DSUR follow-up) unclear.

f.title: Submit 6-monthly interim reports with SAE counts for trials over 6 months
f.statement: Quarterly progress reports and final results/clinical study reports must be communicated to the CSC (Rule 8). For trials lasting more than 6 months, an interim report shall be submitted at 6-month intervals or as directed by the CSC or Pharmacy Services Division, including the number of patients treated, number and type of SAEs reported, number of discontinued patients and the reasons for discontinuation (templates Annexure-XV and XVI).
f.clause: 18.2 Progress and Final Trial Reports/Clinical Study Reports

rows.quote: In the case of trials lasting for more than 6 months, an interim report shall be submitted at 6 months’ intervals or as may be directed by the CSC or Pharmacy Services Division, DRAP. The interim report shall include the number of patients so far treated, number and type of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) reported, number of discontinued patients and the reasons for discontinuation.
rows.location: 18.2 Progress and Final Trial Reports/Clinical Study Reports
rows.review_note: Review: kept for the SAE content; other progress/CSR logistics out of the safety-only scope. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Send ADR/SAE reports by official email and also in hard copy
f.statement: ADRs/SAEs and progress/final reports can be shared through the official DRAP clinical-trial AE reporting email; a hard copy still needs to be shared with the detailed report.
f.clause: 18.2 Progress and Final Trial Reports/Clinical Study Reports

rows.quote: Whereas, hardcopy will still need to be shared with detailed report.
rows.location: 18.2 Progress and Final Trial Reports/Clinical Study Reports
rows.review_note: Review: email address left out (checker rule); statement covers the permitted e-mail channel. Double-check: "will still need to" read as a duty.

f.title: Archive trial documents for at least 5 years and inform DRAP before destruction
f.statement: The principal investigator and the sponsor are responsible for archiving and ensuring the safety of all trial documents. The licence holder/applicant should inform DRAP in writing before destroying the documents. Documents shall be retained for a minimum of 5 years after clinical trial completion, or as required by the sponsor.

rows.deadline: Retain at least 5 years after trial completion; notify DRAP in writing before destruction
rows.quote: It is the responsibility of the Principal Investigator and the Sponsor to archive and ensure the safety of all the documents related to the trial. The license holder/applicant should inform DRAP in writing prior to destroying the documents. Documents shall be retained for a minimum period of 5 years or as per the requirement of the Sponsor, after Clinical Trial completion.
rows.review_note: Review: retention period, no deadline_rule. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Record locations of essential documents; archive system must allow identification and retrieval
f.statement: The sponsor and investigator/institution should maintain a record of the location(s) of their respective essential documents, including source documents. The storage system used during the trial and for archiving, irrespective of media, should provide for document identification, version history, search and retrieval.
f.clause: 20 Essential documents for the conduct of a clinical trial

rows.quote: The sponsor and investigator/institution should maintain a record of the location(s) of their respective essential documents including source documents. The storage system used during the trial and for archiving (irrespective of the type of media used) should provide for document identification, version history, search, and retrieval.
rows.location: 20 Essential documents for the conduct of a clinical trial
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Provide a specimen Adverse Event Report Form with the application
f.statement: The applicant should provide a specimen of the Adverse Event Report Form used to collect data on adverse events related to the study.
f.clause: Annexure: documentary requirements for clinical trial applications, item 16 Adverse Event Reporting form
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: The applicant should provide a specimen of the Adverse Event Report Form for collection of the data related to the adverse events related to the study.
rows.location: Annexure: documentary requirements for clinical trial applications, item 16 Adverse Event Reporting form
